newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia, France to set up agroindustrial committee.
newsitem.headline: Russia, France to set up agroindustrial committee.

text.p: Russian and French ministers signed on Monday a joint declaration of intent to set up a Russian-French Agroindustrial Committee to boost cooperation between both countries' agricultural sectors.

A communique from Russia's Agriculture Ministry said the declaration was signed by Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Zaveryukha and French Agriculture Minister Philippe Vasseur at the end of a three-day visit by Vasseur.
The declaration says the committee will tackle issues of agriculture, forestries, and food industries and help stimulate investment in each other's agroindustrial sectors.
Russian Agriculture Ministry and French Embassy officials could not be immediately reached on Monday for comment.
